categories.main_business_segments: EIKEI Group primarily engages in the design and sales of niche printed circuit boards (PCBs) and industrial PC (IPC) related electronic components. Their product applications focus mainly on automotive electronics and consumer electronics, serving Japanese automotive brands and EMS manufacturers. The company also provides supply chain management, quality control, and logistics services, positioning itself between specialized design firms and large-scale PCB manufacturers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced PCB design and engineering support, including new material applications and quality testing for copper foil substrates. It operates a fabless model, outsourcing production to qualified PCB manufacturers in China and Thailand, while maintaining strict quality and delivery control through on-site teams. R&D focuses on developing high-value products for electric vehicles, AI server cooling solutions, and other emerging applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EIKEI serves mainly Japanese automotive electronics brands and EMS manufacturers, with key customers including Stanley Electric Co., Ltd. and Koito Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The markets targeted include Thailand, Japan, China, and other Southeast Asian countries, with expansion plans into Europe and the Americas. End markets cover automotive lighting, industrial control, consumer electronics, and emerging AI and electric vehicle sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions with subsidiaries and offices in Thailand (main operational hub), Japan, Hong Kong, China (Shenzhen), and Taiwan. Sales and operations extend to Southeast Asia, including Indonesia and India, with plans to expand into North America, Europe, and Mexico. The geographic strategy aligns with the global shift of PCB manufacturing towards Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: EIKEI functions primarily as a midstream supplier in the PCB supply chain, focusing on design, procurement, quality control, and logistics coordination. It does not manufacture PCBs directly but manages a network of qualified manufacturers in China and Thailand. The company acts as a supply chain integrator, providing value-added services such as vendor management, engineering support, and just-in-time inventory solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in new PCB materials and applications, especially for electric vehicles, AI server cooling, and power control modules. It has established a quality laboratory and employs engineers dedicated to material testing and product optimization. Strategic focus includes expanding into high-growth markets like AI, robotics, and high-performance computing, while enhancing global supply chain services and entering European and American markets.
categories.revenue_model: EIKEI generates revenue primarily through sales of PCBs and industrial electronic components. It operates on a project-based sales model catering to niche, low-volume, high-mix orders, mainly for automotive and consumer electronics customers. Additional revenue streams include value-added services such as supply chain management, quality assurance, and logistics support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature and highly competitive PCB industry dominated by large-scale manufacturers. EIKEI differentiates itself by focusing on Japanese clients, providing specialized services, and managing complex, small-batch orders with high quality and delivery reliability. Its strong relationships with Japanese automotive brands and presence in Southeast Asia provide competitive advantages over domestic and Chinese competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, EIKEI reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.76 billion, a 24% increase from 2023, with a net profit of NT$142.5 million, up 29%. The company’s equity grew by 81% to NT$586.9 million, supported by cash capital increases and profit growth. It maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 46% and continues to invest modestly in R&D (about 0.14% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EIKEI emphasizes professional, high-quality service tailored to Japanese customers’ stringent standards, offering integrated solutions from design to delivery. Its value lies in reducing clients’ procurement risks and costs through expert supply chain management, quality control, and flexible logistics. The company’s cultural and linguistic capabilities enable effective cross-border communication, ensuring timely problem resolution and fostering long-term customer loyalty.
